description: This Java source file defines the 'HiveMqtt5PublisherActor' class, an Akka actor responsible for publishing messages to an MQTT 5 broker using the HiveMQ client. The class maps external messages to MQTT publish messages, handles headers, payload construction, and integrates with the MQTT client for publishing.
external_methods: props(final Connection, final Mqtt5Client, final boolean)

classes.name: HiveMqtt5PublisherActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class responsible for publishing MQTT 5 messages using HiveMQ client, extending 'AbstractMqttPublisherActor' with specific mapping and handling for MQTT 5 protocol.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageToMqttMessage
methods.description: Maps an external message and MQTT target into an MQTT 5 publish message, constructing payload, headers, and properties accordingly.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves the topic string from an MQTT 5 publish message.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns an optional payload from an MQTT 5 publish message; currently returns empty.
